req.title: Reject malformed player payload
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity when POST /players/ receives a body that fails Player schema validation.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a 422 Unprocessable Entity status when a malformed player payload is sent to the POST /players/ endpoint. This behavior ensures that only valid data is processed and stored, maintaining data integrity. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct handling of valid data, a negative test to check the response to malformed data, and a boundary test to examine edge cases in data validation.

tests.name: test_valid_player_payload
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with valid player data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid player payload.
expected: The response contains the expected player data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

valid_payload = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=valid_payload)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["firstName"] == "John"
assert response.json()["lastName"] == "Doe"
assert response.json()["squadNumber"] == 27
assert response.json()["position"] == "Forward"

tests.name: test_malformed_player_payload
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with valid player data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a malformed player payload.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating validation failure.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

malformed_payload = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "squadNumber": "invalid_number",
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=malformed_payload)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "validation error" in response.text

tests.name: test_boundary_squad_number
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with valid player data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a squad number at the boundary value.
expected: The response status code is 201 for valid boundary values.
The response status code is 422 for invalid boundary values.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Test with a valid boundary squad number
valid_boundary_payload = {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 0,
    "position": "Midfielder"
}
response = client.post("/players/", json=valid_boundary_payload)
assert response.status_code == 201

# Test with an invalid boundary squad number
invalid_boundary_payload = {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": -1,
    "position": "Midfielder"
}
response = client.post("/players/", json=invalid_boundary_payload)
assert response.status_code == 422
